description: Free. The pump.fun wallet leaderboard, ranked by what copying each wallet would have made: its buys replayed as a follower 1, 3 and 8 slots behind, 0.1 SOL a copy, fees in (follower.delay_1/3/8: net_closed_sol, win_share; own_rank is its rank by its own profit, which is not the same thing: the #1 by own profit lost a follower 120 SOL). The wallets win over their whole record (took out 10+ SOL and 1% more than they put in over 20+ coin-weeks) and traded in the last ~20 days, each with why, its SOL in and out, its coins and its recent pace (trades a day, median hold). sort: own ranks by the wallet's own profit. followable: true keeps the ones a copier can keep up with (under 20 trades a day, a median hold of 2 minutes or more, under half its trades fast). For: who should I copy trade, the best pump.fun traders, smart money wallets. Not pump.fun's own leaderboard, which ranks recent profit. Then wallet_records for any wallet's full record.

followable.description: only wallets a copier can keep up with; default false

limit.description: wallets to return, best first; default 25

sort.description: copyable (default): by what a follower 1 slot behind made; own: by the wallet's own profit

name: top_wallets
